newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Telecom to develop W-CDMA phone technology.
newsitem.headline: Japan Telecom to develop W-CDMA phone technology.

text.p: Japan Telecom Co said on Tuesday it will use wide-band CDMA technology for next-generation digital cellular phone network it plans to launch around 2001.

But the company will not join research and development efforts by cellular phone giant NTT Docomo, which is currently experimenting with its own W-CDMA (code division multiple access) technology, a Japan Telecom official said.
"We should collect experimental data by ourselves, although our technology could be similar to that of NTT Docomo eventually," he said.
Japan Telecom and its cellular phone affiliates will start experiments next spring.
